answer: All new identities must dock at a jetty and pay a deposit to claim one work slot. Each claim must include a sonnet, a structured sample of verified work, so copies are easy to spot. The deposit is frozen like a glacier, thawing over ten epochs and never transferable. A farm making N fakes must lock N deposits for ten epochs and produce N original sonnets, while an honest identity pays once, recovers its deposit, and earns undiluted.
